title: Needleline Spark: compact trace playback + correlation map
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem: Users need a compact, low-noise way to inspect single requests and correlated cohorts across services without losing context or incurring heavy loading times. Existing large trace canvases are great for deep forensics but are overkill for rapid triage workflows and cost-aware debugging. This ticket proposes a lightweight 'Needleline Spark' component that combines a compact timeline lane, correlation map, and a scrubbed playback mode optimized for console dashboards and rollouts UI.

Goals:
- Provide a 1-row-per-service compact timeline (mini-spans) that preserves causal order and duration perception at a glance.
- Allow instant scrubbed playback of a request journey (play/pause, step-by-span, jump-to-error) with keyboard shortcuts.
- Surface correlation metadata (trace id, correlation id, cohort size) and an interactive correlation map showing sibling & downstream request clusters.
- Overlay cost micro-metrics: per-span token-cost estimate and cheap/high-cost flagging to prioritize optimization.
- Support deep-linking into full trace canvas and to the rollout view for degraded model variants.

Constraints & considerations:
- Must be performant on < 1s render for traces with up to 2k spans via virtualization + summarized bloom lanes.
- Respect data sensitivity: redact PII in compact view; follow existing console RBAC and audit patterns.
- Integrate with existing prefix/KV cache indicators from runtime to show cache hit density on mini-spans.
- Should play nicely in small-width panels inside dashboards and in the request drill-down modal.

Deliverables:
- High-fidelity prototype (Figma) of compact lane + correlation map + playback controls.
- Interaction spec for keyboard shortcuts, scrub behaviour, and timeline zoom snap points.
- Accessibility checklist and notes for keyboard-only playback and ARIA roles.
- Implementation handoff docs including suggested props for the timeline React component and expected telemetry events for analytics.
acceptance_criteria: Figma prototype shows compact lane rendering for at least 6 services and a collapsed mode with service initials
Playback controls (play/pause, step-forward, step-back, jump-to-error) are annotated and mapped to keyboard shortcuts in the spec
Correlation map supports hover-to-highlight sibling requests and click-to-open cohort list
Mini-span rendering includes cache-hit tick marks and estimated token-cost color bar
Prototype demonstrates deep-link buttons that open full trace canvas and rollout diagnostics with preserved time cursor
Performance note added: demo with 2k spans loads in under 1s in Chrome with virtualization enabled (mocked data acceptable)
Accessibility notes included and a small a11y audit checklist attached in links
comments: 2025-02-19 - Aisha Patel: Initial discovery session with runtime and eng. Collected requirements on cache tick semantics and token-cost metric. Eng suggested exposing a simplified cost estimator endpoint for the UI.

2025-02-21 - Marco Reynolds: Low-fidelity sketches attached in Figma. Decided on one-row-per-service layout with compact swimlane and a separate mini-correlation-map on the right. Asked PM for priorities on rollout link vs cost overlay.

2025-02-24 - Jun Park (PM): Prioritize quick triage flows. We want playback and jump-to-error first; cost overlays are high value but can be toggled off by default. Please include a lightweight CTA to open the full trace.

2025-02-27 - Sofia Lin (Eng): Reviewed prototype constraints. Suggested using span summarization for services with >200 spans to keep initial paint fast. Will prototype a server-side summarized payload shape. Also requested telemetry events: timeline.play, timeline.step, correlation.view, open-rollout.

2025-02-28 - User Research: Quick 5-user guerilla test with SREs and Platform PMs. Findings: users liked keyboard shortcuts and the compact cost flags; many wanted a 'heat tick' to show retry storms. Added as follow-up UX story.

2025-03-01 - Design review notes: Simplified playback UI to three primary controls + step controls hidden behind hover to reduce visual noise. Need clarity on hover affordances for touch devices. Add focus state for keyboard navigation.

2025-03-03 - Marco Reynolds: Updated Figma link pushed. Preparing PRD with props and telemetry list. Ready for engineering review and can be split into two implementation tickets (compact view + cost overlay/playback).

decisions: Use summarized payloads for services exceeding 200 spans to ensure sub-second initial paint
Playback should only animate span highlights and not re-render entire canvas for each frame
Cost overlay will be opt-in per-user and default to off for the first release
